page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores clocked at up to 4.5 GHz, using simultaneous multithreading with dedicated CPU allocation. It features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction support for AVX-512, AVX-VNNI, and cryptographic accelerators including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The hardware setup includes 32.0 GB of memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, paired with a bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD. Hardware GPU accelerators are not present.

Benchmark evaluation reveals top-tier single-thread performance, with stress-ng single-core tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression achieving upper-decile results. Multi-threaded computational performance scales evenly across its 4 vCPUs, registering average marks in stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU metrics, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performs at a lower tier. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 46.8 GB/sec for reads and 33.7 GB/sec for writes. In database and application benchmarks, the server delivers 7.83 million operations per second in Redis SET routines and 8.35 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Offering an 8-to-1 memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside fast local NVMe storage, the configuration provides efficient resource allocation for data-heavy tasks that do not require wide multi-core scaling. Microsoft Azure E4ads_v7 is well suited for in-memory key-value stores such as Redis, relational database hosting, transactional systems, and enterprise backends requiring high single-core responsiveness.
